title: 第23章 被锁住的人第24章 禁魔领域
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: “末世就是这样的人间炼狱，所以你们最好摆正心态，别有什麽慈悲心。否则，哪天躺在那里的就可能是你们。”
林羽的话如同魔音，让在场的女人都打了个冷颤。
又走了一截，发现了一个大铁门。
刘宇上前，甩出风刃，将铁门撕裂。
里面，一个黑衣青年被锁在房间内。几根粗大的铁链，将他四肢牢牢锁在房间四个角落。
同时，无数的钢筋将他浑身卡死，直接延伸到了他的脖子之处，让他动弹一下都做不到。
更可怕的是。
他的小腿上，贯穿了两根钢筋，伤口处，血液早已凝结。
巨大的响声，让青年睁开了双眼。
“你们不是王浩的人，你们是谁？”青年看着眼前几人问道。
“你又是谁？王浩又是谁”林羽反问。
听到这话，青年确认几人不是王浩的人，顿时眼睛亮了起来，接着又黯淡了下去。
“我原本是这个奥尔玛超市的占领者，後来我外出杀丧尸，王浩的弟弟来到了这里，这个禽兽他居然侮辱了我老婆……”
“我赶回来的时候，一切都晚了，我老婆也自杀了。”
青年说到这的时候，咬牙切齿。
“我将那滚蛋大卸八块，丢去喂丧尸了，可我老婆再也回不来了。”
“那你又怎麽成现在这样了？”
“後来，王浩带着人来了，他将我囚禁在这里，日日折磨。”
青年眼中充满了恨意。
“只要我不死，终有一天，我要送这些王八蛋去地狱，他们全都是禽兽。”
“王浩就是现在占领超市的这些人？”陈静儿问道。
“没错，就是他们。各位，我不知道你们来干嘛，但我劝你们还是赶紧走吧。”
青年看着几人道：“等王浩他们回来，你们的下场会很惨的，特别是这三个女人。”
“你不想让我们救你？”林羽很是好奇。
青年摇了摇头。
“你们现在走还有机会，要是救了我，王浩是不会放过你们的。”
“你是条汉子，可惜你的好意我们要辜负了。”
林羽走上前去，握住那一根根锁链，微微用力，锁链直接崩断。
青年看到这一幕，眼神微凝。
接着，林羽将囚住青年的钢筋，轻而易举的掰开，将人救了出来。
他握住洞穿青年小腿上的钢筋，猛的一拔。
content_en:
"The end of the world is such a purgatory on earth, so you'd better correct your mentality and don't have any compassion. Otherwise, you may be the one lying there one day."
Lin Yu's words were like magic sounds, making all the women present shiver.
After walking a little further, I found a large iron gate.
Liu Yu stepped forward, threw out the wind blade, and tore the iron door apart.
Inside, a young man in black was locked in the room. Several thick iron chains locked his limbs firmly in the four corners of the room.
At the same time, countless steel bars stuck him all over, extending directly to his neck, making it impossible for him to move.
What's even scarier is.
There were two steel bars running through his calf, and the blood had already condensed at the wound.
The huge noise made the young man open his eyes.
"You are not from Wang Hao, who are you?" the young man asked, looking at the people in front of him.
"Who are you? Who is Wang Hao?" Lin Yu asked back.
After hearing this, the young man confirmed that these people were not Wang Hao's people, and his eyes suddenly lit up, and then dimmed again.
"I was originally the occupier of this Orma supermarket. Later, when I went out to kill zombies, Wang Hao's brother came here. This beast actually insulted my wife..."
"When I rushed back, it was too late and my wife also committed suicide."
When the young man said this, he gritted his teeth.
"I cut that bastard into pieces and threw them to feed the zombies, but my wife will never come back."
"Then why are you like this?"
"Later, Wang Hao came with his men, and he imprisoned me here and tortured me every day."
The young man's eyes were filled with hatred.
"As long as I don't die, one day I will send these bastards to hell. They are all beasts."
"Wang Hao is these people occupying the supermarket now?" Chen Jing'er asked.
"Yes, it's them. Everyone, I don't know why you are here, but I advise you to leave quickly."
The young man looked at the group of people and said, "When Wang Hao and the others come back, your end will be very tragic, especially these three women."
"You don't want us to save you?" Lin Yu was very curious.
The young man shook his head.
"You still have a chance to leave now. If you save me, Wang Hao will not let you go."
"You are a man. It's a pity that we have to live up to your good intentions."
Lin Yu stepped forward, held the chains, and applied a slight force, and the chains broke.
When the young man saw this scene, his eyes narrowed slightly.
Then, Lin Yu easily broke open the steel bars imprisoning the young man and rescued him.
He grasped the steel bar that pierced the young man's calf and pulled it out fiercely.
